name: Is painting enough, or do I need a full bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: Is painting enough, or do I need a full bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in many cases painting and trim work can update a bathroom without a full remodel. It is a good fit when the layout works but the room looks dated, scuffed, or unfinished.
acceptedAnswer.description: If the bathroom layout is fine and the issue is mostly cosmetic, painting and trim work can be a smart alternative to remodeling.
